evidence_items.explanation: The April benchmark supports the error-prone component. It compares agents with humans, not consumer deployments with workplace automation, and does not measure tolerance.

Enterprise agents also had substantial limitations. These earlier results caution against assuming workplace automation was a reliable baseline, but cannot establish a matched difference between settings.
